newsitem.title: EGYPT: Kuwait says Iraqi vessel enters its waters.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait says Iraqi vessel enters its waters.

text.p: Kuwait has lodged a complaint with the Arab League saying an Iraqi vessel violated its territorial waters and opened fire on a Kuwaiti patrol boat, a spokesman for the league said on Thursday.
Arab League spokesman Tala'at Hamed confirmed to Reuters a report about the complaint in Kuwait's al-Rai al-Ram newspaper, which said the vessel and crew had been arrested.
The newspaper quoted a memorandum filed by Kuwait as saying of the alleged incident "Kuwait's government considers this act a serious violation".
Kuwaiti officials were not available for immediate comment.
"When the sea target (Iraqi vessel) was approached (by a Kuwaiti patrol boat) the patrol was surprised by several bullets being fired at it from a light machine gun," said the memorandum.
The Iraq-flagged vessel, observed in Kuwaiti waters on Saturday, and its crew have been detained, it said without elaboration.
Iraq invaded Kuwait in August 1990 and annexed it for seven months. A U.S.-led coalition ousted Baghdad's troops after a six-week offensive.
